coverage: Directed primary-source radar with version-pinned catalogue metadata. Bibliographic coverage is never proof coverage.

source_cards.title: OpenAI mathematics manuscript collection
source_cards.claim: Current README and parsed CONTENTS report721 manuscripts in373 families. Relative to the preserved719/372 snapshot, two PDF links are added and none removed. Three withdrawal notices remain preserved.
source_cards.limits: New statement reading is separately scoped; no new full proof or upstream Lean build audited. Publisher formalization percentages are not our certification.
source_cards.reuse: Bibliographic metadata and original synthesis; no copied abstracts, proofs or inferred training permission.

source_cards.title: Discovering state-of-the-art quantum circuits with large language models
source_cards.claim: Selected design, validity, statistical guarantees and Appendix A were read. The evaluator explicitly tracks phase and ancilla cleanup; the stated failure guarantee depends on the actual input distribution. The appendix recovers divstep branch bits from reachable integer states.
source_cards.limits: Not a full46-page audit or gate replay of the complete published engine. Selected task contract, metadata and decoder sections were read in pinned primary code. New independent finite references match a common cleanup model; their costs are not whole point-adder counts or a capacity gain.
source_cards.reuse: Bibliographic metadata and original synthesis only.

source_cards.title: Claude-shaped science
source_cards.claim: Schwartz describes BootLoops as a harness for exact calculations and cross-field hypothesis generation, with domain-expert selection of scientifically useful targets.
source_cards.limits: Methodological context, not a theorem proving the value or novelty of our proposed connections; implementation and scientific claims were not reproduced.
source_cards.reuse: Original short synthesis, not redistribution of the article.

source_cards.title: AlphaEvolve: How our Gemini-powered coding agent is scaling impact across fields
source_cards.claim: DeepMind describes search guided by evaluators, with examples in optimization, quantum circuits and mathematical counterexample search.
source_cards.limits: Explicitly dated background, not a new October paper. Reported scientific and engineering performance is not independently reproduced here.
source_cards.reuse: Original short synthesis only.

source_cards.title: Formal Conjectures repository
source_cards.claim: The repository distinguishes formalized conjecture statements from proved theorems and documents immutable benchmark tags and possible statement inaccuracies.
source_cards.limits: A Lean statement or a finite instance does not prove the original conjecture. This sweep did not count current open statements or build the repository; an earlier local count is not treated as current.
source_cards.reuse: Metadata and source links. Per-source rights and benchmark boundaries remain applicable.

source_cards.title: Lyapunov stability of polynomial vector fields is undecidable
source_cards.claim: Korda reports undecidability in a fixed higher dimension and degree, and decidability of the usual stability notions for planar homogeneous fields.
source_cards.limits: Abstract and earlier documented planar supplement reading reused; no new full proof or Lean build. Polynomial-certificate existence, stability, computable size and practical running time are distinct questions.
source_cards.reuse: Bibliographic metadata and original synthesis.

source_cards.title: On Algebraic Proofs of Stability for Homogeneous Vector Fields
source_cards.claim: Theorem 3.1 already gives rational Lyapunov functions of the form P divided by a power of the squared radius for asymptotically stable homogeneous systems; section 7 asks about coefficient-dependent bounds.
source_cards.limits: The existence theorem is prior work. The proposed planar encoding bound must be checked separately and does not answer the arbitrary-dimensional question.
source_cards.reuse: Bibliographic metadata and original synthesis; cited sections, not copied text.

source_cards.title: A Globally Asymptotically Stable Planar Homogeneous Polynomial Vector Field With No Polynomial Lyapunov Function
source_cards.claim: The paper gives a planar homogeneous polynomial-certificate obstruction. LemmaIII.3 and familyIV-D were reread: their Fourier estimate also yields a short attributed rational-certificate degree consequence.
source_cards.limits: The inferred exponential dense-output scale is not a literal bit-complexity theorem stated in the source. It must not be presented as an independent new lower-scale discovery; no exhaustive historical-priority claim or Lean replay.
source_cards.reuse: Bibliographic metadata and original synthesis.

source_cards.title: Finite convex interpolation for polynomial Lyapunov existence
source_cards.claim: The exact public PDF is the 20-page manuscript linking all-degree polynomial certificates in the rotating planar class to a finite interpolation threshold, with restricted quantitative and angular-zero results.
source_cards.limits: Working paper, not AIRR acceptance. Its public aggregate is 3.20 from other reports; the involved Astra report gave technical 9 and importance 7. Reports disagree and are preserved; no score is transferred to proposals. No human or formal verification is claimed.
source_cards.reuse: Author's bibliographic metadata and original synthesis.

source_cards.title: Lluis Eriksson author catalogue at ai.viXra
source_cards.claim: The author listing is accessible in this sweep and enumerates 135 entries, including mathematical-physics and matrix-analysis papers.
source_cards.limits: Listing availability and entry numbers are verified, not all 135 proofs. Previous local 404 observations are historical and do not describe current availability.
source_cards.reuse: Bibliographic metadata and source links only.

source_cards.title: What the Machine Invented: Mining New Mathematical Instruments from OpenAI’s October 2026 Release of AI-Generated Mathematics
source_cards.claim: Ying Xie extracts proposed proof instruments from 38 selected OpenAI families and records antecedents, dependencies and caveats. Introduction, methodological limits, cross-cutting patterns and selected entries were read.
source_cards.limits: This survey does not certify the source proofs or priority. No Lean project was built by its author. Our reading is selected sections, not 38 reconstructed arguments; source manuscripts must be checked before reuse.
source_cards.reuse: Bibliographic metadata and short original synthesis only; no source full text or training permission is redistributed.

source_cards.title: Algebraic Lyapunov Functions for Homogeneous Dynamic Systems
source_cards.claim: The authors study implicit algebraic homogeneous Lyapunov functions defined by a positive root, using a homogeneous invariant polynomial equation.
source_cards.limits: Mathematical body read in primary HTML. This is antecedent context for certificate classes; no claim that the present construction replaces their method or proves its optimality. No software reproduction.
source_cards.reuse: Bibliographic metadata and short original synthesis only; no source full text or training permission is redistributed.

source_cards.title: Algorithms in Real Algebraic Geometry: A Survey
source_cards.claim: Basu surveys effective real quantifier elimination and sign determination; the author PDF Theorem 2.18 gives formula and coefficient-size bounds.
source_cards.limits: Theorem 2.18 and associated discussion read, not the whole survey. Effective real algebraic elimination is prior technology; its use does not by itself prove the new Lyapunov construction or novelty.
source_cards.reuse: Bibliographic metadata and short original synthesis only; no source full text or training permission is redistributed.

source_cards.title: Amortized Bound for Root Isolation via Sturm Sequences
source_cards.claim: Theorem2(i) and nearby controlled-subresultant analysis were inspected in the primary scanned PDF. They supply polynomial binary complexity for the univariate sign and root computations used in the certificate verifier.
source_cards.limits: This does not justify unrestricted rational-remainder coefficient growth or prove the Lyapunov construction. Selected pages3–5, not the entire paper.
source_cards.reuse: Bibliographic metadata and original short synthesis only.

source_cards.title: Family095: nonliftable cones and a liftable nonspectrahedral example
source_cards.claim: Introductions and main statements of two pinned companion manuscripts were read. One claims a high-dimensional hyperbolicity cone without a finite lift; another gives a size100 lift with307 auxiliaries for a particular23-variable nonspectrahedral cone. These are different examples.
source_cards.limits: Neither full proof was audited. No map identifies our convex interpolation body with either cone. Nonspectrahedrality alone does not prohibit a lift. A pointwise Gram factor is not automatically a joint linear matrix pencil.
source_cards.reuse: Bibliographic metadata and original short synthesis only; no PDF or source text redistributed.

source_cards.title: Solving Open Research Problems Together
source_cards.claim: The official announcement presents six collaborations and discusses concurrent Gaussian-ellipsoid threshold results. It distinguishes claims, attribution and human review arrangements.
source_cards.limits: Announcement only; none of the six technical proofs or concurrent papers was audited here. No new theorem or priority decision follows from the announcement.
source_cards.reuse: Bibliographic metadata and original short synthesis only.

source_cards.title: Breaking the high-degree barrier in Lehmer’s problem with a human–AI discovery loop
source_cards.claim: The authors combine polynomial search with exact verification and a five-parameter construction. Selected Section4 passages distinguish tested irreducibility through degree2000 from broader asymptotic construction claims.
source_cards.limits: Abstract and selected Section4 only; appendix proofs, irreducibility records and distributed searches have not been reproduced. This is not a solution of Lehmer’s conjecture.
source_cards.reuse: Bibliographic metadata and original short synthesis only; no source-text redistribution or inferred training permission.

source_cards.title: OpenAI partially disproves Littlewood’s 1961 L-alpha-flat theorem
source_cards.claim: The author argues that the counterexample concerns a hyper-lacunary class outside an intended implicit hypothesis. Selected statements illustrate the need to preserve the exact problem dictionary.
source_cards.limits: The critique is an author claim, not an adjudicated correction. Its displayed transition from a supremum bound to pointwise ultraflatness needs separate scrutiny; the upstream proofs and historical sources have not been jointly audited.
source_cards.reuse: Bibliographic metadata and original short synthesis only; no source-text redistribution or inferred training permission.

source_cards.title: Lean-QuantumAlg: A Framework for AI Agents to Produce Quantum Algorithms that Humans Can Trust
source_cards.claim: The framework binds correctness, resource bounds and joint borrowed-state restoration to one execution. Selected introduction and contract passages explain why separate resource counts or locally restored marginals are insufficient.
source_cards.limits: Abstract and selected contract sections only; no Lean build, package audit or independent reproduction of its nine demonstrations. The authors’ less-than-one-percent review metric is not a correctness guarantee.
source_cards.reuse: Bibliographic metadata and original short synthesis only; no source-text redistribution or inferred training permission.

source_cards.title: Reset minimax laboratory
source_cards.claim: Original finite entropy-game diagnostics preserve an initial false solver-success case and a corrected28-case replay with two linear-program best responses per case. The Linux/Windows matrix40065903227 passed all28 cases on each platform.
source_cards.limits: Finite floating-point checks with explicit cutoff; no interval, formal, quantum-capacity or continuum certification. Check actual CI for platform coverage.
source_cards.reuse: Bibliographic metadata and original short synthesis only; no source-text redistribution or inferred training permission.

source_cards.title: Lorentzian polynomials: derivative signatures and nonnegative changes
source_cards.claim: Theorem2.25 supplies the M-convex-support and quadratic-derivative characterization; Theorem2.10 preserves Lorentzianity under nonnegative linear changes. Selected dependent-audit passages also cover homogeneous stable inclusion.
source_cards.limits: Not a full-paper audit, worldwide-priority search or a statement that every Lorentzian polynomial is stable. The own counterexample is separate from these source claims.
source_cards.reuse: Bibliographic metadata and original synthesis only; no source-paper full text or inferred training permission.

source_cards.title: Log-concavity and Approximate Counting for Totally Unimodular Polytopes
source_cards.claim: The main statements give line log-concavity and capacity-based approximation for unimodular/TU fiber counts. Question1.7 asks for Jensen over finite distributions with integer barycenter.
source_cards.limits: Introductory statements and open question read; no complete proof audit. The own bounded probes and proposed partial reductions do not solve the general question.
source_cards.reuse: Bibliographic metadata and original synthesis only; no copied proof or inferred training permission.

source_cards.title: Erdos-Hajnal for paths and beyond: source statements and closures
source_cards.claim: Selected graph/closure definitions, theorem statements and Stage2 hypotheses were read. The README acknowledges Nguyen preceding the all-path result. The actual master theorem enforces non-vacuous fixed-constant compatibility.
source_cards.limits: Not a complete source proof audit or Lean build. The S222 reduction remains a speculative target; an elementary closure obstruction and finite witness are not an EH proof or priority certificate.
source_cards.reuse: Metadata, source links and original analysis; private text snapshots retain license and transformation records, no source full texts in this repository.

source_cards.title: Erdos-Hajnal for excluding paths
source_cards.claim: Theorems1.2 and1.3 state the EH property for all paths and the specified S_(1,2,t) and edge-added families; introduction and concurrent-work account were read.
source_cards.limits: No full bookkeeping/splitting-path proof audit. This is a prior result, not our extension; omitted families are not thereby certified worldwide-open.
source_cards.reuse: Bibliographic metadata and original short synthesis only.

source_cards.title: Graphs with No Long Claws: An Improved Bound for the Analog of the Gyarfas Path Argument
source_cards.claim: Theorem3 gives either an induced S_ttt or removal of at most3t+11 neighborhoods followed by a balanced rigid extended strip decomposition. Selected overview and limitations were read.
source_cards.limits: Not a complete proof or algorithm replay. The authors improve a quasipolynomial MWIS bound; no calibrated Stage1 EH transfer or polynomial-time conclusion is supplied here.
source_cards.reuse: Primary link and original synthesis only.

source_cards.title: Fermat Last Theorem Lean artifact: verification contract
source_cards.claim: The pinned README describes the FLT statement, standard-axiom gate, comparator and second-kernel checks, with explicit resource requirements and provenance.
source_cards.limits: No local full build, comparator or second-kernel replay. Formalization of known FLT is not a new mathematical discovery of this ledger.
source_cards.reuse: Metadata and verification-contract summary only; no imported proof corpus or inferred training permission.

source_cards.title: Sharp Plücker Geometry for Three-Copy Werner Distillation
source_cards.claim: Section7.2 contains the Schur and signed co-Choi tensor mechanism; AppendixC.2 restricts both supports to locally orthogonal product codes. These are prior inputs, not a new tensorization principle.
source_cards.limits: Selected sections and explicit hypotheses compared; no complete external formalization build or worldwide-priority audit. A support plane containing one GHZ ray need not satisfy the full code-plane hypothesis.
source_cards.reuse: Bibliographic metadata and original synthesis only.

source_cards.title: How to share a quantum secret
source_cards.claim: Equations1–2 supply the known three-qutrit encoding basis used in the explicit Werner-sector example and recovery from two shares; single-share reductions reveal no logical state.
source_cards.limits: Encoding, recovery and adjacent erasure discussion read; not the whole paper or an attribution of any new Werner certificate to the source. The code and its erasure property are prior.
source_cards.reuse: Bibliographic metadata and original synthesis only.

source_cards.title: Local smoothing for the Euclidean wave equation
source_cards.claim: Theorem1.1 on page1 states an arbitrarily-small-loss Euclidean half-wave estimate for n>=2 and2<=p<infinity; page3 lists Fourier and Kakeya consequences. This is the manuscript claim, not our proof verification.
source_cards.limits: Only first3PDFpages text read, firstpage visually inspected. No full proof audit, executable algorithm replay or upstream Lean verification. Claims remain provisional. Formal SAT challenge/JSON and imports inspected separately; a challenge sorry is not a solution-module defect.

source_cards.limits: Only first3PDFpages text read, firstpage visually inspected. No full proof audit, executable algorithm replay or upstream Lean verification. Claims remain provisional. Formal SAT challenge/JSON and imports inspected separately; a challenge sorry is not a solution-module defect.

candidates.lost_or_unproved: General solver, useful explicit constants, higher dimensions and exhaustive priority remain unestablished. The exponential dense lower scale is an attributed consequence of a prior Fourier lemma, not an independent discovery. Final candidate3 has an exact-artifact8.9 technical/4.3 importance report, not an importance above7.
candidates.hypothesis_to_remove: Nonvanishing angular velocity in the existing quantitative certificate-size analysis; use rational rather than polynomial certificates.
candidates.falsifier: A stable planar input that defeats an angular sign case, invalidates a margin or forces a second exponential in the stated encoding proof.

candidates.title: Which convex interpolation bodies admit useful semidefinite lifts?
candidates.dictionary: A convex jet body -> candidate lifted positivity representation; cone examples -> controls on representation claims.
candidates.preserved: Convexity, input encoding and exact feasible-set quantifiers.
candidates.lost_or_unproved: No direct implication from hyperbolicity-cone results to the quadrant interpolation body has been proved. Nonspectrahedral does not mean no semidefinite lift.
candidates.hypothesis_to_remove: Opaque weak-membership oracle implementation, if an explicit valid lift exists.
candidates.falsifier: The proposed lift fails a two-node or singular confluent interpolation instance, or its domain does not match the cone theorem.
candidates.next_finite_task: Construct and test an explicit two-node interpolation representation, including singular and confluent boundaries. First state the actual set map; abandon any argument based only on the shared words convex or hyperbolic.
candidates.review_packet: Two primary introductions/main statements now read with immutable PDF hashes. The examples have different dimensions and representation classes; no contradiction or transfer to our body is established.

candidates.title: Reversible-circuit evaluators versus communication resource guarantees
candidates.dictionary: Reversible arithmetic circuit -> implementable channel; qubit and gate budget -> candidate operational resource constraint.
candidates.preserved: Reversibility, ancilla initialization and cleanup, exact action on basis states.
candidates.lost_or_unproved: Coherent action, error accumulation, noisy-channel capacity and physical cost are not established by classical truth-table tests alone.
candidates.hypothesis_to_remove: An uncosted implementation assumption in an operational protocol, if a certified circuit supplies it.
candidates.falsifier: A phase, ancilla or coherence counterexample despite correct classical outputs; or a gate-count gain that worsens the actual protocol cost.
candidates.next_finite_task: Specify the actual protocol input distribution and composition error before transferring a resource saving. Abandon a universal capacity or channel-norm claim inferred only from TQ or average-input tests.
candidates.review_packet: Selected primary validity sections already include exact phase, ancilla cleanup and distribution-aware failure bounds. A phase-blind critique would duplicate safeguards the source already has. Integer recurrence reproduction is linked in the follow-up note; no gate implementation or capacity result.

candidates.title: Finite counterexample search with a checked statement dictionary
candidates.dictionary: Original conjecture -> formal statement -> exact finite instance -> proof or counterexample certificate.
candidates.preserved: Quantifiers, integer domains, endpoint conditions and equivalence to the original question.
candidates.lost_or_unproved: A solved finite instance need not advance the asymptotic problem; a benchmark statement can be misformalized.
candidates.hypothesis_to_remove: Unverified translation between the published conjecture and the searched finite problem.
candidates.falsifier: The formal and original statements disagree on a small case or the output is merely a known table.
candidates.next_finite_task: Reuse recorded Green/Erdos triage and negative results before choosing a different conjecture; compare the original statement before running a solver.
candidates.review_packet: Existing small-value notes are not promoted to major discoveries.

candidates.title: Clean high-depth decoders versus stored divstep history
candidates.dictionary: Reachable integer branch invariant -> Boolean decision oracle; Boolean implementation -> coherent decoder with explicit phase and workspace cleanup.
candidates.preserved: Exact branch value on reachable states; fixed modulus, depth flags and complete reversible interface.
candidates.lost_or_unproved: No improved quantum circuit, clean-workspace construction, resource gain, universal runtime guarantee or novelty has been established. The underlying formula is prior work.
candidates.hypothesis_to_remove: The need to store every expensive high-depth decision, only if a cheaper fully accounted clean decoder exists.
candidates.falsifier: Any wrong reachable branch, residual phase or dirty workspace; or disappearance of savings after controls, scratch qubits and reverse cleanup are counted.
candidates.next_finite_task: Apply a substantive-hypothesis gate before writing a manuscript: require a validated complete-protocol Pareto improvement or a new asymptotic/structural theorem. Include selector, routing, scratch lifetimes and later predicate death. Deprioritize a standalone paper based only on the finite oracle counts.

candidates.title: Exact fixed-ratio loss for quantum identity/replacement channels
candidates.dictionary: Quantum branch conditional entropy -> uniform classical entropy game -> positive discrete saddle certificates -> fixed energy-ratio limiting loss.
candidates.preserved: Fixed transmission probability, separate mean-energy constraints, known reset channel, order of infimum and supremum, full infinite oscillator model in the analytical argument.
candidates.lost_or_unproved: No unknown-channel universal code, finite-energy exact capacity, regularized C/P/Q result, uniqueness of every optimizer, exhaustive priority claim or importance grade.
candidates.hypothesis_to_remove: A fixed reset state or negligible reset budget; quantify the positive loss when reset energy grows proportionally to input energy.
candidates.falsifier: A coherent-input or dephasing counterexample to the uniform reduction; a failed global saddle inequality, singular Riemann limit or feasible-sequence construction; an earlier equivalent theorem.
candidates.next_finite_task: Freeze and review the full manuscript in a fresh Astra context, preserving any adverse result. Finish the thermal-comparison supplement separately. Keep known depolarizing binary-entropy plateau attributed to Bennett et al.1999.
candidates.review_packet: Internal reused-context audits48/50/51 support the threshold, uniform quantum-to-classical reduction and explicit atom/diffuse certificate limit. These are conditional chains, not fresh full-paper review, human review or Lean verification. The first solver failure and all corrected finite runs remain available in the linked laboratory. No assigned paper importance.

candidates.title: Transfer the stable singleton law to Lorentzian homogenizations
candidates.dictionary: Stable PGF boundary event -> means and coefficient preserved under a Lorentzian homogeneous extension.
candidates.preserved: The exact degree-five counterexample preserves normalization, means(1,3/5), and canonical homogenization.
candidates.lost_or_unproved: Lorentzianity does not imply the sharp stable singleton bound; the correct Lorentzian envelope and minimal failing degree remain undetermined.
candidates.hypothesis_to_remove: Replace real stability by Lorentzian canonical homogenization without changing the two-mean lower bound.
candidates.falsifier: A normalized Lorentzian-canonical PGF below both stable branches; an exact degree-five example now supplies it.
candidates.next_finite_task: Replay the published exact checker and retain the barrier; do not continue searching for a proof of the refuted extension.
candidates.review_packet: Two-mean manuscript has its separate exact-draft4.0importance/8.0quality assessment. No score for this extension. Dependent154research and root exact reconstruction verify the counterexample; no Lean claim.

candidates.title: Global Jensen for unimodular finite lattice fibers
candidates.dictionary: Integer right-hand sides -> exact fiber counts -> log-count concave envelope at integer barycenters.
candidates.preserved: Unimodular system, finite fibers, nonnegative integer solutions and exact integer barycenter.
candidates.lost_or_unproved: A line inequality does not imply Jensen for arbitrary finite supports. Proposed low-kernel-dimensional reductions still need review and prior-art comparison.
candidates.hypothesis_to_remove: The line-supported restriction on the distribution of right-hand sides.
candidates.falsifier: An exact unimodular system and rational finite weights with integer barycenter violating the Jensen inequality; all fiber counts and finiteness must be certified.
candidates.next_finite_task: A TU-specific structural gluing lemma or an exact violating weighted-binary distribution is still needed. Avoid repeating the same finite LP range as a universal proof.
